ruleContent.content:
<js>
// 从 baseUrl 提取书籍 ID 和章节 ID
let aid = baseUrl.match(/books\/(\d+)\//)[1];
let cid = baseUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\.html/)[1];

// 从页面源码中提取服务器预置的校验参数
let token = result.match(/chapterToken\s*[:=]\s*'([^']+)'/)[1];
let timestamp = result.match(/timestamp\s*[:=]\s*(\d+)/)[1];
let nonce = result.match(/nonce\s*[:=]\s*'([^']+)'/)[1];

// 构造包含校验信息的请求参数字符串
let params = `aid=${aid}&cid=${cid}&token=${token}&timestamp=${timestamp}&nonce=${nonce}`;

// 定义包含 gbk 编码和移动端 UA 的请求配置
let options = {
    "charset": "gbk",
    "headers": {
        "Referer": baseUrl,
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Android 7) Mobile",
        "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest"
    }
};

// 发起异步请求并提取返回 JSON 中的正文内容
result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`https://www.deqixs.co/modules/article/ajax2.php?${params},${JSON.stringify(options)}`)).data.content;
</js>
ruleContent.replaceRegex:
<js>
// 转义标题变量中的特殊字符，确保正则安全
let safeTitle = title.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

// 根据标题长度动态匹配并清理正文中的重复标题行
if (title.length < 5) {
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${safeTitle}\\s*\\n`, "i"), "");
} else {
    let shortTitle = safeTitle.substr(0, Math.floor(safeTitle.length * 2 / 3));
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${shortTitle}.*\\n`, "i"), "");
}

// 匹配并移除以“第X章”开头的特征行，防止章节名残留
result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*第\\S+?章.{0,${title.length}}\\n`, "i"), "");

// 清理文末各种括号格式的“本章完”字样
result = result.replace(/\s*[（|(]本章完[)|）]\s*/g, "");

// 批量清理官方广告及推广干扰语
let officialRules = [/更新不易.+?看最新章节！/g, /更新不易.+?看最新无错章节！/g, /更新不易.+?最新小说章节！/g, /速读谷/g, /速.读.谷/g, /速 读 谷/g, /本章节未完.+?请订阅/g];
officialRules.forEach(rule => result = result.replace(rule, ""));

result;
</js>

ruleExplore.coverUrl:
<js>
let bookUrl = result.select("h4>a").attr("href");
let bookId = bookUrl.match(/(\d+)/)[1];
let imageBaseUrl = "https://www.deqixs.co/files/article/image/";
let imageDetailUrl = `${parseInt(bookId / 1000)}/${bookId}/${bookId}s.jpg`;
imageBaseUrl + imageDetailUrl;
</js>
